name: No Casus Belli
description: Justice is nothing else than the interest of the stronger. It is our own might that gives us the right to conquer the weak. They shall not request, nor expect leniency as none will be given.

name: War From Event
description: Regrettably, the events leading to this situation made the conflict unavoidable, nonetheless, force will succeed where diplomacy failed. We will defend our ideals with the sword and prevail against our wicked enemies.

name: Subject Broke Free
description: One of our subjects has had the audacity of rebelling against our rule, openly disobeying our orders and insulting our authority. We shall teach them a lesson in humility and return them to their place under the yoke.

name: Insulted Us
description: They have brought this upon themselves. Long have our people endured their rudeness and disrespect, and it will not continue any longer. We will use their blood to cleanse their last insult from our honor.

name: Supported Rebels
description: We will honor our agreements and join our brothers in their fight against tyranny. Together we will succeed, and finally bring peace and stability to the region.

name: Declined Call to Arms
description: It is finally time to teach those cowards a lesson. Those oathbreakers, who run to their homes during our hour of need will see them burn, as we shall rain just wrath, and rightful vengeance upon their cities.

name: Denied Military Access
description: Their unreasonable closeness has forced our hand, if they will not allow safe passage to our troops through their land, our forces will carve a way through by sword and fire.

name: Following Through On Threat
description: We are men of honor, our word is gold, and they will soon learn that we do not speak lightly. Our troops will now teach them that they should have followed our suggestions when we provided them and that going against our wishes is a mistake they will soon regret.

name: Destroyed Buildings
description: They have destroyed our buildings and need to pay for it!

name: Trade War
description: We will no longer continue tolerating their hostile commercial activities. We will defend the interest of our merchants and our economy by any means necessary.

name: Border Feud
description: Time and trickery have seen our most distant regions fall under the tyrannical rule of our neighbor, but the time has finally arrived to make things right and regain control over all the land that is rightfully ours.

name: Religious Conformance
description: The religious conformity of our neighbors is of utmost importance. Matters of faith should not be taken lightly and as such we must intervene, weeding out potential heresies and prevent our flock from going astray.

name: Annex
description: Their country will succumb to our superior might, and we shall annex them into our domain, by force if necessary.

name: Maritime Dominance
description: They threaten our hegemony over the sea!

name: Destabilized Our State
description: Through vile and backhanded tactics, our enemies have attempted to subvert our authority over our subjects and incited rebellions within our borders! For the safety of our people, justice must be done, and our wretched enemies must be destroyed!

name: Livonian War
description: A conflict between two powers over the future of the [ShowAreaName('baltic_area')] area. The result of this war will decide who will get to have warm water ports in the lands of the former #italic Terra Mariana#!.

name: Claim $TIM_ADJ$ Realm
description: A conflict between a governor within $TIM$, the purpose being the claim the realm for themselves.

name: Invasion of China
description:
The old wounds between the [GetInternationalOrganization('middle_kingdom').GetName] and the forces of $india$. A mad campaign against old enemies, we will stop at nothing until they are completely crushed.

This [casus_belli|e] allows for cheaper conquest of [locations|e] within [ShowSubContinentName('east_asia')].

name: Restoration of $ADU$
description:
The [ShowReligionGroupAdjective('christian')] rule over [ShowRegionName('iberia_region')] must end. Let us march and restore $ADU$!

Should we manage to own [ShowLocationName('cordoba')] as well as #Y 80%#! of [ShowAreaName('andalusia_area')] after the war, we will gain an event to become $ADU$

name: Incursion into [GetCountry('ENG').GetNameWithNoTooltip]
description: Our [GetCountry('FRA').GetAdjective] allies have requested we honor the terms of the Auld Alliance and launch an invasion of [GetCountry('ENG').GetName]. With [GetCountry('ENG').GetNameWithNoTooltip] committed to the war in [GetCountry('FRA').GetNameWithNoTooltip], this allows [GetCountry('SCO').GetName] an opportunity to capture the neighboring border provinces.

name: Subjugation
description: They are resisting to bend their knees before us. We shall force them to do so!

name: Scaliger War
description: The [ShowDynastyName('scala_dynasty')] domains must be reduced to ashes!

name: Italian League Subjugation
description: Our victory in the Italian Wars has earned us the right to bring our former league-mates to heel. The time for negotiation has passed.

name: Restore $ROM_ADJ$ Borders
description: The splendor of the old Empire calls to us. It is time for the phoenix to spread its wings, dooming all those who dare stand between us and our ambition to restore the [ShowScriptedGeographyName('roman_borders_geography')] of old.

name: Anti-Piracy War
description: Pirates, buccaneers, and corsairs must be afforded no quarter. We shall sink these sea dogs who prey on our unarmed merchantmen and spread their terror in our waters.

name: Attack Threatening Rival
description: As they are a [threat|e] and a [rival|e] we have an obligation to fight them.

name: Seize Fur Supply
description: Hunters have hunted our local beaver population into dwindling numbers, we must acquire new hunting grounds to fulfill the demands of the fur trade!

name: Break free from the Tatar Yoke
description: Casting off the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('tatar_yoke').GetName] will weaken the stranglehold of the [GetCountry('GLH').GetLongName] over the Russian principalities.

name: Challenge for League Leadership
description:
Our state has proven itself the dominant power in the [GetSituationByKey('italian_wars').GetName]. We will force our league's leader to yield command — or crush them in battle.

#Y Requires the [ShowPeaceTreatyTypeName('challenge_league_leadership_peace_treaty')] [peace_treaty|e]#!

name: Claim Throne
description: The opportunity to install our preferred candidate as the head of another country, is not one we should pass up on. By claiming the throne of a foreign state, we will expand our domain and cement our dynasty's power and influence.

name: Coalition
description: The warmongering ways of our neighbors must be curbed, lest we risk falling victim to their expansionist tendencies.

name: Colonial Conflict
description: We want to take over their colonial empire, to enrich ourselves.

name: Colony War
description: We want to take over more of the New World.

name: Destroy Enemy
description: They have declared us as their [rival|e], so we definitely have a cause to fight them.

name: Claims on Province
description: Lands under the jurisdiction of our neighbors should rightfully belong to us, on the basis of a sturdy and legitimate claim!

name: Crusade
description: It falls upon our shoulders to lead the faithful in a successful crusade against our heathen enemies!

name: Crush Hussitism
description: The garden of our faith has been infested with a powerful new sect. We must take quick action and protect our believers.

name: Cut Down in Size
description: Our foes have grown too powerful to be ignored. We need to strike decisively and inflict a fatal blow before our rivals can attempt to retaliate.

name: Religious War
description: Our nation aspires to be the epitome of religious obedience and fervent faith. As such, we cannot allow our general domain to be pestered by heretics or heathens.

name: Disloyal Subject
description: One of our subjects dares raise its gaze against our authority, as we wish to preserve our overlordship, they must be cut down and brought back in line.

name: Disrupting Trade
description: The commercial activity of our foes cannot continue to antagonize and sap our income, this matter should be dealt with immediately.

name: Dissolve the Tatar Yoke
description: Dismantling the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('tatar_yoke').GetName] will set the Russian principalities free. Let us seize the moment and put an end to the dominance of the [GetCountry('GLH').GetLongName].

name: Excommunicated Ruler
description: Their ruler has been excommunicated! They are a disgrace to the Lord and the Holy See, and must be punished!

name: Expansion into the Steppes
description: The $tatar_yoke$ is no more. It is time to claim the steppes for ourselves!

name: Exploration
description: What lies beyond our shores will soon no longer be a mystery. We must extend our reach and influence to include the folk that live beyond our shores.

name: Dubious Claims on Province
description: Lands under the jurisdiction of our neighbors should "rightfully" belong to us, on the basis of a sturdy and "legitimate" claim!

name: Flower Wars
description: The maintenance of our empire, and the world, require a constant stream of captives. Only through a state of constant warfare can we ensure that we have access to such a supply. The world cannot afford peace.

name: Force Migration
description: We cannot maintain a prosperous community and exploit the land effectively while having local tribes around our borders. We must force them to relocate.

name: Force into our Faction
description: They are not one of us! We must show them the error of their faulty ways!

name: Great Northern Conflict
description: In a bid to challenge the influence of our [ShowCultureGroupName('scandinavian_group')] foes, the decision has been made to take up arms and wrestle over the control of lucrative lands and trade routes across the [ShowAreaName('baltic_area')].

name: Take Down Hegemon
description: The ambition and prestige tied to being a Hegemon must only be matched by the most powerful nations. All shall bend the knee against our might and splendor!

name: Hegemon Ultimatum
description: This pathetic excuse of a state refuses to oblige with our demand. If they do not want to bend their knee willingly, then our sword shall force them.

name: Cleanse Heresy
description: Burn the Heretics! Extinguish their faulty world views in the name of our faith!

name: Overthrow High King
description: As great warriors, High Kings are expected to welcome challengers in war to prove their own worthiness as protectors of the land.

name: Reclaim High Kingship Land
description: High Kings are chosen defenders of the kingship lands, and are expected to use their force to reclaim land taken by external powers.

name: Subjugate High Kingship Member
description: It is our right as a member of the High Kingship to subjugate our neighbors through the use of force. After all, they would do the same to us.

name: Horde Expansion
description: There can be no peace between tribes and settlers! Their possessions belong to the Horde!

name: Raiding Retaliation
description: We shall retaliate against the enemies that raided our population.

name: Imperial Liberation
description: An Imperial Prince has fallen under the overlordship of a foreign ruler. We can not risk their influence in the empire to grow and need to liberate this poor country.

name: Humiliate
description: We must remind them of their inferiority compared to us!

name: Humiliate Rival
description: Our rivals think they are better than us. We must prove them fatally wrong!

name: Conquer the Throne of France
description: The conflict over who should rule France can only be settled on the battlefield.

name: Defend the Throne of France
description: $cb_hundred_years_war_desc$

name: Unify the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('ilkhanate').GetNameWithNoTooltip]
description: All the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('ilkhanate').GetName] shall be unified under our rule!

name: Refuse the False Claimant
description: We shall not permit a false claim to the leadership of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('ilkhanate').GetName].

name: Shed the Shackles of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('ilkhanate').GetNameWithNoTooltip]
description: The foreign [ShowCultureGroupName('mongolian_group')] rule of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('ilkhanate').GetName] must disappear. We shall unify [ShowRegionName('persia_region')] under our banner.

name: Imperial Ban
description: They hold Imperial Land! It must be liberated from them!

name: Imperialism
description: They will be better off in our glorious empire!

name: Independence
description: Give us liberty, or give us death!

name: Secure Italy
description:
The [GetSituationByKey('italian_wars').GetName] are tearing [ShowRegionName('italy_region')] apart. As a member of a league, we have a right to claim Italian territories for our cause.

#Y Conquest is restricted to [ShowRegionName('italy_region')]#!

name: Jihād
description: It falls upon our shoulders to lead the faithful in a successful jihad against the infidels!

name: Latin Reconquest
description:
It is time to reclaim the lost lands of the [GetCountry('LAT').GetLongNameWithNoTooltip]!

Using the [ShowCasusBelliNameWithNoTooltip('cb_lat_reconquest')] [casus_belli|e] restricts the conquest of lands outside the [ShowScriptedGeographyName('frankokratia_geography')].

name: League of the Public Weal
description: The authority of the King of France has grown too powerful! We must forcefully seek concessions from the King to ensure our own autonomy.

name: Lōdī Claims
description:
With the [ShowDynastyName('lodi_dynasty')] claims over [ShowLocationName('delhi')], it is time that we declare ourselves the true rulers of $india$!

#Y Enables the [ShowPeaceTreatyTypeName('peace_claim_delhi')] [peace_treaty|e]#!

name: Make [ShowSubjectTypeNameWithNoTooltip('tributary')]
description:
Force them to be our [ShowSubjectTypeName('tributary')].
$casus_belli_forbids_location_conquest_tt$

name: $nanbokuchou$
description: The $nanbokuchou$ is a time of conflict. We must take advantage of the situation.

name: Nationalist
description: People of our culture are under their rule!

name: Native Subjugation
description: Force a [society_of_pops|e] to accept our rule!

name: Parliament Approved Claims on Province
description: $cb_conquer_province_desc$

name: Prevent Annexation
description: Prevent our rivals from illegally annexing their defenseless subjects!

name: Push Back Colonizers
description: We must push back the invaders from our land!

name: $red_turban_rebellions$
description:
The tyranny of $YUA$ has been tolerated for long enough! It is time for China to be ruled by the [ShowCultureGroupName('chinese_group')] once again!

#Y Enables the [ShowPeaceTreatyTypeName('rtr_rein_in_rebellion')], [ShowPeaceTreatyTypeName('rtr_demand_occupied_territories')], and [ShowPeaceTreatyTypeName('rtr_demand_all_chinese_territories')] [peace_treaties|e]#!

name: Rein in the Rebels
description:
The pathetic [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('red_turban_rebels').GetName] have the audacity to revolt against our rule. They must be reined in!

#Y Enables the [ShowPeaceTreatyTypeName('rtr_rein_in_rebellion')], [ShowPeaceTreatyTypeName('rtr_demand_occupied_territories')], and [ShowPeaceTreatyTypeName('rtr_demand_all_chinese_territories')] [peace_treaties|e]#!

name: Regional Supremacy
description:
Those pretenders assume they can govern China. We must teach them the error of their ways, and conquer their land for ourselves!

#Y Enables the [ShowPeaceTreatyTypeName('rtr_demand_complete_annexation')] [peace_treaty|e]#!

name: Religious Superiority
description:
The religious conflict between the [protestant|e] and [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] factions of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName] must find its end - even if it has to be on the battlefield!

#Y Enables the [ShowPeaceTreatyTypeName('religious_supremacy')] [peace_treaty|e]#!

name: Resist Annexation
description: Our [overlord|e] has started to [annex|e] us! We should fight them before it is too late and our [country|e] ceases to exist.

name: Crush the Revolution
description: We cannot allow a torrent of despicable ideas to spread across our borders, lest we risk losing our crown as well.

name: Spread the Revolution
description: The fires of freedom and revolution will burn brightly beyond our borders. They have nothing to lose but their chains!

name: Take the Shogunate
description: We have the right to become $JAPANESE_SHOGUNATE_LEADER_MALE$, let us take it.

name: $sengoku$
description: The $sengoku$ engulfs the whole country in constant wars and conflict.

name: Expand Clan Authority
description: We must expand the authority and influence of our clan.

name: Rebel Against the $JAPANESE_SHOGUNATE_LEADER_MALE$ Authority
description: The [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('japanese_shogunate').GetName] is pressing their authority too much, it is time for us to rebel against it.

name: Reassert $JAPANESE_SHOGUNATE_LEADER_MALE$ Authority
description: The many clans under us do not respect our authority as they should, it is time to put them in place.

name: Slave Raiding
description:
We need to address our need for more slaves for our markets!

Whenever our [armies|e] take over a [location|e] part of the [pops|e] will become [ShowPopTypeName('slaves')] in one of our nearby [ShowBuildingTypeName('slave_market')] buildings.

name: Sound Tolls Exemptions Broken
description: They broke the sound toll exemption!

name: [GetCharacter('chg_timur_lame_borjigin').GetShortNameWithNoTooltip]'s Conquest
description: In the name of the great conqueror, their lands shall belong to us!

name: Trade Conflict
description: They are threatening our trade!

name: Tribal Feud
description: Our Tribe is mightier than their Tribe!

name: Unify $china$
description: The lands of $china$ must once again be united under the single banner of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('middle_kingdom').GetName]!

name: Claim Mandate of Heaven
description: $china$ is lost without a proper and strong leadership. We are such leadership, and is our duty and our destiny to establish ourselves as the leaders of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('middle_kingdom').GetName]

name: Union Independence
description: We shall not bend our knee before any false monarch! Our fate is our own!

name: War for Seniority
description: They are not worthy to represent the great union! We shall enforce our superiority, and take control over the union for ourselves!
